question_cn: 2026 世界杯小组赛 E 组：德国 vs 科特迪瓦（2026-06-20，多伦多）90 分钟三路赛果？
question_en: 2026 FIFA World Cup Group E: Germany vs Côte d'Ivoire (2026-06-20, Toronto) — 90-minute three-way result?
one_liner_cn: Elo 差 237 分加上德国五连胜状态，德国约 64% 胜率；科特迪瓦预选不败保留约 15% 爆冷空间，平局约 21%。
one_liner_en: A 237-point Elo gap plus Germany's five-match winning streak puts Germany near 64%; unbeaten-in-qualifying Côte d'Ivoire keep about a 15% upset chance, draw around 21%.

key_reasons.cn: Elo 差 237 分（德国 1932 第 10 vs 科特迪瓦 1695 第 49），Davidson 统计模型即给德国约 62%。
key_reasons.en: 237-point Elo gap (Germany 1932, No. 10 vs Côte d'Ivoire 1695, No. 49); the Davidson statistical model alone gives Germany about 62%.

key_reasons.cn: 德国近 5 场全胜，主力框架齐整：仅轮换级的 Karl 伤退，诺伊尔小腿伤预计无碍本场。
key_reasons.en: Germany on five straight wins with the first-choice core intact: only rotation player Karl withdrew injured, and Neuer's calf strain should clear well before this match.

key_reasons.cn: 科特迪瓦预选赛 8 胜 2 平不败、净胜 +25，Kessié/Ndicka/Pépé 领衔的阵容具备搅局能力，但 Haller 落选削弱锋线兜底。
key_reasons.en: Côte d'Ivoire went 8W 2D unbeaten with +25 goal difference in qualifying; a squad led by Kessié, Ndicka and Pépé can disrupt, though Haller's omission thins the striker fallback.

method_note: Market-blind: Davidson three-way Elo model (scale=400, drawNu=0.7, neutral venue, no host bonus) on the eloratings.net snapshot, p_stat 62.1/22.0/15.9, plus a bounded evidence adjustment (+1.5pp to Germany, cap ±8pp) from dated sourced facts; fully independent of any betting or prediction-market data.
